name: artcraft_upload_image
description: Upload a local image file for use as a generation reference. Reads a local file and sends it to ArtCraft; requires confirm: true. File must live inside the user's home directory (or ARTCRAFT_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS), be an image type, and be <= 50 MB.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this local file may be read and uploaded.

file_path.description: Local path to an image (png/jpg/jpeg/webp/gif/bmp/avif) inside an allowed directory
